clips.title: The story
paras: The Forest's Bounty is a local quest in Shadowgale Forest where a timid forager asks for help collecting fallen acorns. Fierce predatory raptor-birds prowl the deeper woods, making harvesting too perilous without an adventurer's protection. The gathered acorns are then roasted into a tasty forest meal.

A cautious forager seeking food in Shadowgale Forest finds themselves in a bind. While acorns lie scattered across the woodland floor, the surrounding trees are prowled by fierce, raptor-like creatures. Having gathered whatever fell near safety, the forager depends on passing travelers to venture into the wilder groves so that neither goes hungry.

Shadowgale Acorns provide hearty sustenance for those who know how to prepare them. Though bitter or tough in the raw, roasting them over a crackling fire transforms the wild harvest into a rich, roasted treat. Braving the predatory birds among the timber turns a simple woodland scavenge into a warm meal shared in the wilderness.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!
So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Mmm, I think you are going to like what I can cook up with these acorns!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, stranger! You'll find that these are delicious once roasted!
Please excuse me, it won't take me long to whip this up.
